messages:
Lina (product): brief sync 1: customer asks: rolling upgrades must preserve tenant egress IPs; they want a slim installer that relies on customer-managed NAT. where does this land on roadmap and what are must-have specs?
Matt (eng): two technical routes: operator-shim to orchestrate safe canaries or quick sidecar replace. operator gives safer rollback and drain control. main risks: KV cache churn and serving pod drain.
Sarah (netops): egress IP stability is a hard requirement for some accounts. support customer NAT (preferred) + our relay fallback. doc should show BGP peering snippet and static-route example.
Jill (devops): packaging: propose presets: full (relay+telemetry), slim (minimal agent, expects customer NAT), airgap. slim needs post-install ip-pin check and an install flag.
Lina (product): launch criteria idea: 1) rolling upgrades with no >1min p99 latency spike, 2) pinned tenants keep same egress IP during rollout, 3) slim preset validated on 2 field pilots, 4) canary + rollback runbook published.
Matt (eng): test plan: harness that simulates ~100 tenants pinned to IPs, rollout path canary->10->50->100, measure KV hit-rate and tail latencies. add endpoint `/health/upgrade-ready` to indicate safe drain.
Sarah (netops): runbook snippet: BGP neighbor example `neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65000`, iptables fallback and quick validation `curl -sS https://ifconfig.me` (note privacy).
Jill (devops): installer flags draft: `installer_mode: slim`, `preserve_egress: true`, `relay_enabled: false`. will add `--force-ip-check` post-install.
Lina (product): prioritization: recommend high priority (Q2) because it unlocks enterprise deals. need rough effort estimate for roadmap.
Matt (eng): rough: operator+canary infra ~4 eng-sprints (2 engineers), packaging ~1 sprint (1 engineer), netops docs & tests ~0.5 sprint. field validation adds ~2 weeks.
Sarah (netops): will coordinate two field validation windows: one for BGP peering, one for customer NAT.
Lina (product): action owners: @Matt -> PRD stub + canary plan by Tue; @Jill -> slim flags + ip-check script by Fri; @Sarah -> egress runbook + examples by Thu; @ops-bot -> create shiproom ticket.
ops-bot: created ticket RDW-5371 "private-deploy: egress-pin + rolling-upgrade lanes" assigned to Lina, Matt, Jill, Sarah. :white_check_mark:
Matt (eng): ack, starting PRD.
Jill (devops): prototyping ip-check tomorrow.
Sarah (netops): pulling customer configs for examples.
Lina (product): i'll fold estimates into roadmap and schedule a 30-min walkthrough next Mon. end.
